nav.label: Main
level.off.desc: Nothing of this kind is skipped.
level.light.desc: Skips only the scenes we are very sure about, mild or strong. Scenes we are unsure about play.
level.moderate.desc: Skips the scenes we are fairly sure about, mild or strong. Only the most doubtful ones play.
level.strict.desc: Skips every scene we found, mild or strong, even ones we are unsure about. Best for young children.
level.light.descLanguage: Mutes only the words we are very sure about.
level.moderate.descLanguage: Mutes the words we are fairly sure about. Only the most doubtful ones are heard.
level.strict.descLanguage: Mutes every word we found, even when we are unsure.
preset.little-kids.desc: Strict for everything, bad words muted too. The strictest choice.
preset.teens.desc: Clear scenes of nudity, sex and gore are skipped; kissing and hints only when we are sure.

settings.language.lead: The app and the messages in the player follow this choice.
settings.pin.lead: The PIN guards settings, reviews and the library. Kids only see movies you approved.
settings.pin.recovery: Forgot it? On the kid screen press Parent, then I forgot my PIN, and use your recovery code.
settings.about.lead: bonis oculis checks movies once, here on this computer, so the whole family can simply press play.
privacy.lead: Everything stays on this computer. bonis oculis works without the internet.
privacy.never.network: Connects to the internet. There is no code in it that opens a network connection.
privacy.never.account: Asks for an account, an email or a password.
privacy.never.telemetry: Sends usage data, crash reports or statistics.
privacy.never.frames: Saves a clear picture of a flagged scene. Thumbnails are blurred before they touch the disk.
privacy.never.share: Shares your library or your choices. Exports happen only when you press a button.
privacy.limitsTitle: What the PIN can and cannot do
privacy.limits: The PIN is a lock for the family, not a safe. It keeps kids out of settings and reviews, and settings are signed so changes made outside the app are noticed.
privacy.bypass: A person with an administrator account on this computer can get around it, for example by deleting the app's data. Keep the administrator account for grown-ups.

settings.aside.title: What this means
settings.aside.default: Point at a kind of scene on the left to see what each level does.
settings.thorough: Thorough scan (slower, looks at more scenes)
settings.thorough.help: Describes many more scenes in words, so hints without nudity are caught more often. A scan can take several times longer.
settings.listenSpeech: Listen to speech when there are no subtitles
settings.listenSpeech.help: Writes down what is said so bad words and suggestive talk can be found. Adds time to movies without subtitles.

acc.title: Check accuracy
acc.lead: See how close our scan comes to scenes you marked yourself.
acc.how: Choose a skip file in which you marked every scene of this movie by hand, separately from this movie's own list (for example a list a friend made, or one made with another tool). We compare it with the automatic scan, before your review, so your own decisions do not make us look better.
acc.empty.title: No comparison yet
acc.empty.text: Choose a hand-marked file for this movie. The result is kept here for next time.
acc.noMovies.title: Nothing to compare yet
acc.noMovies.text: Scan a movie first. Then you can compare it with your own marks.
acc.summary: We caught {caught} of what you marked, and missed {missed}. We also flagged {falseAlarms} that you did not mark.
acc.summary.noTruth: Your file marks no scenes, so there was nothing to miss. We flagged {flagged} in this movie.
acc.otherCopy: The hand-marked file was made for a different copy of this movie, so times may be shifted and the numbers may look worse than they are.
acc.help.recall: Of the seconds you marked, the share we flagged too. Higher means fewer misses.
acc.help.precision: Of the seconds we flagged, the share you marked too. Higher means fewer false alarms.
acc.help.f1: One number that balances Caught and Correct.
acc.help.missed: Missed = scenes you marked that we did not catch, in time.
acc.help.false: False alarms = time we flagged that you did not mark.
acc.help.hit: Of the scenes you marked, the share we caught at least in part.
acc.na: Nothing of this kind to compare
acc.honest: Measured on this one movie, second by second; a scene counts as caught if we flagged any of it within {tolerance} s. Other movies can do better or worse. We set the app to catch too much rather than too little, so expect more false alarms than misses.
error.evalFailed.title: The comparison did not finish

cat.nudity.def: Bare private parts or a naked body on screen, including partly covered ones.
cat.sex.def: Sexual activity shown or heard, even with clothes on: sex scenes, intimate touching, sexual sounds.
cat.implied.def: Sex suggested but not shown: a couple in bed, sounds from off screen, a cut away just before or after.
cat.kissing.def: Long or passionate kisses on the mouth. A quick peck is usually not flagged.
cat.gore.def: Blood, open wounds, injuries or bodies shown in a graphic way. Fighting without blood is usually not flagged.
cat.language.def: Swear words and crude sexual words in the dialogue. These are muted, not skipped.
cat.other.def: Scenes you marked yourself while watching, or hid with the panic key.
